items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Julia was playing piano in the band then because Jesse Stone had quit. That was his original piano player, Jesse Stone.

ctx.x: Yeah, I've heard about those days in Kansas City. That's right.

Yeah, I played with George E. Lee as Julia's brother. Yeah. And Julia was playing piano in the band then because Jesse Stone had quit. That was his original piano player, Jesse Stone. Yeah, I was in the band for George E. Lee's band.
How long were you around that section?
